data.one_liner: Configurable modal progress indicator widget blocking access to its subtree.
data.what_it_does: Wraps a widget and displays a modal progress indicator over it based on a boolean visibility flag. It allows configuring background color, opacity, and blur effects.
use_when: You need to block user interaction with a widget while an asynchronous operation is running.
You want a simple modal loading overlay with customizable background options.
avoid_when: You need a complex state-management architecture built into your loading indicators.
strengths: Easy to wrap around any existing widget and its subtree.
Configurable background color, opacity, and blur effects.
weaknesses: Limited feature set beyond basic modal progress blocking.
data.minimal_example:
ModalProgressIndicator(
  visible: true,
  indicator: CircularProgressIndicator(),
  options: BackgroundOptions(
    color: Colors.black,
    opacity: 0.5,
    blurEffect: BlurEffect(
      sigmaX: 1.5,
      sigmaY: 1.5,
    ),
  ),
  child: child,
)
